story.title: Our Story
story.quote: Nostrum is born of the grove
story.label: Mediterranean coast

scenes.s0_copy: A single grove on the Mediterranean coast. Old trees, patient soil, salt in the air.
scenes.s1_copy: Four generations, one grove. Nothing here is rushed, and nothing is left to chance.
scenes.s2_copy: Picked at first light, at the peak of ripeness — then pressed the very same day.

process.aria: How our olive oil is made
process.title: How it is made
process.step1_copy: Hand-picked at first light, at the peak of ripeness.
process.step2_copy: Leaves and stems away — only clean fruit remains.
process.step3_copy: Stone-milled to a paste, slowly kneaded to free the oil.
process.step4_copy: Separated below 27°C, so nothing of the fruit is lost.
process.step5_copy: Sealed fresh from the mill — first cold pressing only.
